name: Requirements & Constraints
purpose: Turn the bounded Intent Definition and pinned current facts into traceable, testable requirements and constraints without choosing architecture, build planning, implementation, or routes.
completion_criteria: The Requirements Definition contains at least one functional requirement, quality requirement, constraint, or invariant with a unique stable ID and pinned source references.
Every expected outcome and success signal in the Intent Definition is covered by at least one non-question requirement item.
All source JSON Pointers resolve inside the pinned Intent Definition, Current Context, or Effective Policy, and no blocking open question remains.
Core writes a new immutable Requirements revision, updates the Intent-local current pointer, records its SHA-256, and advances only through the fixed ST-03 to ST-04 Graph edge.
stop_conditions: An input, Work Request, base revision, source reference, Plan, Core State, or existing immutable revision is missing, malformed, tampered, stale, or inconsistent.
A stable ID is duplicated, required Intent coverage is absent, a source pointer is dangling, or a later-Stage field or secret-bearing field is proposed.
A blocking question, value judgment, requirement conflict, policy exception, priority choice, or risk acceptance remains unresolved.
Core cannot acquire the Workspace lock or persist canonical revision JSON, current pointer, Audit, and State records.
